title: OSHC 来电确认明天动物园 excursion
titleEn: Vacation care calls about tomorrow's zoo excursion
scene: 学校的 OSHC（课前课后托管）这周在办 vacation care（假期托管）。你给孩子订了明天（周二）去 Adelaide Zoo 的 excursion，协调员 Kylie 打电话来确认：几点送到、要签同意书、要带什么、费用多少、谁来接。
你的目标：听清时间和价格；告诉她明天由朋友 Mei 来接，问清怎么把 Mei 加到授权名单；最后请她发短信确认。

vocab.zh: 假期托管（学校假期里的全天托管）
vocab.ex: We've booked two days of vacation care this week.
Tomorrow's excursion is to Adelaide Zoo.

vocab.zh: 家长同意书（也叫 consent form）
vocab.ex: Please sign the permission form in the app.
Drop-off is by 8:45, and pick-up is any time till six.
Don't forget to sign them out on the iPad at pick-up.
Is your friend an authorised person on the account?
They'll need a packed lunch and two snacks.

vocab.zh: 不含坚果（很多学校禁带）
vocab.ex: We're a nut-free centre, so no peanut butter, please.

vocab.zh: 不戴帽子不能去户外（防晒规定）
vocab.ex: It's going to be hot, and it's no hat, no play.

vocab.zh: 扣掉政府补贴（CCS）后你自己付的部分
vocab.ex: After the subsidy, your gap fee is about thirty dollars.
There's a late fee if you pick up after six.
The bus leaves at nine fifteen on the dot.

listening.en: Hiya, is that Amy? It's Kylie from OSHC. How're you going?
listening.sound: Hiya = hi there；How're you going 连读成 “howya goin'”，going 的 g 基本不发音
listening.zh: 你好，是 Amy 吗？我是 OSHC 的 Kylie，你好吗？
listening.reply: Good, thanks Kylie. How are you?

listening.en: Just a heads-up, the bus leaves at quarter past nine on the dot.
listening.sound: quarter past 连成 “quarta-pas”，t 吞掉；on the dot 读得很快像一个词
listening.zh: 提醒一下，巴士九点一刻准时出发。
listening.reply: Got it, nine fifteen. So what time should we be there?

listening.en: If you could get 'em here by quarter to, that'd be awesome.
listening.sound: 'em = them；that'd be 读成 “thad-be”；quarter to 后面省略了 nine，就是 8:45
listening.zh: 你能在八点四十五前把孩子送到就太好了。
listening.reply: No worries, we'll be there by quarter to nine.

listening.en: I'll flick it through the app this arvo — just pop your signature on it.
listening.sound: flick = 发（给你）；arvo = afternoon 下午；pop = put，pop your signature on it = 签个名
listening.zh: 我今天下午在 app 里发给你，你签个名就行。
listening.reply: Great, I'll sign it as soon as I get it.

listening.en: Who's doing pick-up? Coz if it's not you, they've gotta be on the list.
listening.sound: coz = because；gotta = got to（必须）；who's doing pick-up = 谁来接
listening.zh: 谁来接？如果不是你，那个人必须在授权名单上。
listening.reply: My friend Mei is picking up. How do I add her to the list?

listening.en: Too easy. Anyway, I'll let you go — enjoy the rest of the long weekend!
listening.sound: too easy = 没问题、小事一桩；I'll let you go 是礼貌地结束通话，不是“放你走”
listening.zh: 没问题。好啦不耽误你了，周末剩下的时间玩得开心！

speech.topic: 你怎么给孩子安排假期、上班的同时怎么接送、打电话时最难的是什么
paragraphs: I'd like to talk about how I plan my child's school holidays. In South Australia, the school holidays are about two weeks long, but I don't get two weeks off work. I work full-time as a business analyst, so I need a plan.

First, I look at the holiday program at our school's OSHC. They send it out about a month before the holidays. Each day has a different activity. Some days they stay at school and do arts and crafts or cooking. Other days they go on an excursion, like the zoo, the beach or the movies. I usually pick the excursion days, because my child gets really excited about them.

Second, I book early. The popular days fill up fast, so I try to book as soon as the program comes out. I also check the cost. The excursion days are more expensive, but with the Child Care Subsidy, the gap fee is still okay for us.
Third, I take a few days off myself. This time I took a couple of days off, so we had some time together. We went to the park, had a picnic and visited the library.

The hardest part for me is the phone calls. The staff are very friendly, but they speak fast and they use a lot of short forms, like arvo and drop-off. Sometimes I don't catch the time or the price. Now I always ask them to send me a text to confirm.
Overall, the holidays are busy, but with a good plan, they can be fun for both of us.
speech.zh: 我想讲讲我怎么安排孩子的学校假期。在南澳，学校假期大约两周，但我没有两周的假。我是全职的业务分析师，所以需要提前计划。第一，我会看学校 OSHC 的假期活动表。他们大概在放假前一个月发出来。每天的活动都不一样，有时候在学校做手工或做饭，有时候出去玩，比如动物园、海边或看电影。我一般选外出的日子，因为孩子特别期待。第二，我会早点预订。热门的日子很快就满，所以活动表一出来我就订。我也会看费用。外出的日子更贵，但有托儿补贴，自付部分对我们来说还可以。第三，我自己也请几天假。这次我请了两天，所以我们有一些一起的时间。我们去了公园、野餐，还去了图书馆。对我来说最难的是打电话。工作人员都很友好，但他们说话快，还用很多简略说法，比如 arvo、drop-off。有时候我没听清时间或价格。现在我都会请他们发短信确认。总的来说，假期很忙，但只要计划好，我们俩都能过得很开心。

patterns.zh: 我想讲讲……（开头） 例：I'd like to talk about my first week in a new job.
我通常……，因为…… 例：I usually book early, because the popular days fill up fast.

patterns.en: The hardest part for me is ___.
patterns.zh: 对我来说最难的是…… 例：The hardest part for me is understanding fast phone calls.

patterns.en: Now I always ___ to make sure ___.
patterns.zh: 现在我总会……，确保…… 例：Now I always ask for a text to make sure I've got the right time.

lines.en: Hiya, is that Amy? It's Kylie calling from the OSHC at school. How're you going?
lines.zh: 你好，是 Amy 吗？我是学校 OSHC 的 Kylie。你好吗？

lines.en: Oh, hi Kylie. I'm good, thanks. How are you?
lines.zh: 哦，你好 Kylie。我挺好的，谢谢。你呢？

lines.en: Yeah, not bad, not bad. Bit hectic with vacation care, but all good. Look, I'm just ringing about tomorrow, coz you've got your little one booked in for the zoo excursion. So just a heads-up, the bus leaves at quarter past nine on the dot, so if you could get 'em here by quarter to, that'd be awesome. We do a headcount and a quick toilet stop before we head off, so the earlier the better, really.
lines.zh: 嗯，还行还行。假期托管有点忙，不过都挺好。是这样，我打电话是说明天的事，因为你给孩子订了明天去动物园的活动。提醒一下，巴士九点一刻准时出发，所以你能在八点四十五前送到就太好了。出发前我们要点人数、让孩子们上个厕所，所以越早越好。

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? What time should we be there?
lines.zh: 抱歉，能慢一点再说一遍吗？我们应该几点到？

lines.en: Oh, sorry, I'm talking a hundred miles an hour! Drop-off by eight forty-five. Quarter to nine. The bus goes at nine fifteen.
lines.zh: 哎呀不好意思，我说太快了！八点四十五前送到，差一刻九点。巴士九点十五走。

lines.en: Got it, eight forty-five. Thanks.
lines.zh: 明白了，八点四十五。谢谢。

lines.en: No worries. Now, the permission form. I'll flick it through the app this arvo. Just pop your signature on it and hit submit. If it's not signed by tomorrow morning, they can't get on the bus, unfortunately.
lines.zh: 不客气。还有，同意书。我今天下午在 app 里发给你，签个名点提交就行。如果明早之前没签，孩子就上不了巴士，没办法。

lines.en: OK, I'll sign it tonight. Is it the same app we use for bookings?
lines.zh: 好的，我今晚签。是我们订位用的那个 app 吗？

lines.en: Yep, same one. It'll come up under Forms.
lines.zh: 对，同一个。会出现在 Forms（表格）那一栏。

lines.en: Great. And what do they need to bring?
lines.zh: 好的。那孩子需要带什么？

lines.en: So, a packed lunch, two snacks and a water bottle. Remember we're nut-free, so no Nutella, no peanut butter, nothing like that. A hat's a must. It's no hat, no play, and it's meant to be twenty-eight tomorrow. And if you can, pop some sunscreen on 'em before they come.
lines.zh: 嗯，一份自带午饭、两份零食、一个水壶。记得我们不能带坚果，所以不要 Nutella、花生酱这类东西。帽子必须带，不戴帽子不能户外活动，明天说是有 28 度。可以的话，来之前给孩子先抹好防晒。

lines.en: Just to confirm, you mean lunch, two snacks, water, a hat, and sunscreen before drop-off?
lines.zh: 确认一下，您是说午饭、两份零食、水、帽子，还有送来前抹好防晒？

lines.en: Spot on. Oh, and they've gotta wear the green OSHC T-shirt, so we can spot 'em in the crowd. Have you got one?
lines.zh: 完全正确。哦，还有要穿绿色的 OSHC T 恤，这样人多的时候我们能一眼认出来。你们有吗？

lines.en: Yes, we got one last term. Can I ask about the cost? Is the zoo day more expensive?
lines.zh: 有，上学期买了一件。我能问一下费用吗？动物园那天会更贵吗？

lines.en: It is, yeah. It's sixty-eight dollars for the day, but that's before the Child Care Subsidy. After CCS, your gap fee should be somewhere around twenty-five, thirty bucks.
lines.zh: 是的，会贵一点。一天 68 块，不过这是扣托儿补贴之前的价格。扣掉 CCS 以后，你自付大概二十五到三十块。

lines.en: Sorry, did you say sixty-eight or seventy-eight?
lines.zh: 抱歉，您说的是 68 还是 78？

lines.en: Six-eight. Sixty-eight. Now, who's doing pick-up tomorrow? Coz if it's not you, they've gotta be on the authorised list, and they'll need to bring photo ID.
lines.zh: 六、八，68。那明天谁来接？如果不是你，那个人必须在授权名单上，还要带有照片的证件。

lines.en: My friend Mei is picking up tomorrow. I don't think she's on the list yet. How do I add her?
lines.zh: 明天我朋友 Mei 来接。她应该还不在名单上。我怎么把她加上去？

lines.en: Easy. Just go into the app, under Contacts, add her full name and mobile, and tick 'authorised to collect'. Do that before tomorrow and you're all good.
lines.zh: 简单。在 app 里进 Contacts（联系人），加上她的全名和手机号，勾选“授权接送”。明天之前弄好就没问题了。

lines.en: Will do. And what time do they get back from the zoo?
lines.zh: 好的。那他们几点从动物园回来？

lines.en: We should be back by about half three, but pick-up's any time till six. After six there's a late fee. It's a dollar a minute, so, you know.
lines.zh: 我们大概三点半回来，不过六点前随时都可以接。六点以后有迟接费，一分钟一块钱，所以你懂的。

lines.en: OK, I'll tell Mei to come before six. Could you send me a text with the times, just so I've got it in writing?
lines.zh: 好的，我会让 Mei 六点前到。能把时间发短信给我吗？这样我有个书面记录。

lines.en: Yeah, too easy. I'll shoot you a quick text after this. Anything else you wanna ask?
lines.zh: 好的，没问题。挂了电话我就给你发个短信。还有别的想问的吗？

lines.en: No, I think that's everything. Thanks so much for calling, Kylie.
lines.zh: 没有了，应该都清楚了。非常感谢你打电话来，Kylie。

lines.en: No worries at all. I'll let you go. Enjoy the rest of the long weekend!
lines.zh: 不客气。那我不耽误你了，长周末剩下的时间玩得开心！

lines.en: Thanks, you too. Bye!
lines.zh: 谢谢，你也是。拜拜！

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 抱歉，能慢一点再说一遍吗？

rescue.en: Sorry, was that fifteen or fifty?
rescue.zh: 抱歉，是 15 还是 50？（数字听不准就直接问）

rescue.en: Could you spell that for me, please?
rescue.zh: 能帮我拼一下吗？（名字、街名、app 名称）

rescue.en: Could you text me the details, so I've got it in writing?
rescue.zh: 能把细节发短信给我吗？这样我有书面记录。

checklist: 盲听时听出了送到时间（8:45）和发车时间（9:15）
角色扮演时至少用了 2 次追问句
演讲讲满 2 分钟，中间没有长时间卡住
演讲里用了 3 个今天的新表达
